headline: Iran closes Strait of Hormuz to vessel traffic over ceasefire violations
summary: The Khatam al-Anbiya Central Headquarters announced the closure as a 'first step' in response to alleged US and Israeli breaches of commitments.
details: Iran's top joint military command, the Khatam al-Anbiya Central Headquarters, announced on Saturday that the Strait of Hormuz would be closed to vessel traffic.
The decision was reported by Iran's Mehr state news agency, citing alleged violations of a ceasefire agreement by the United States and Israel.
Military command stated that this closure serves as the 'first step' in response to what they described as breaches of commitments.
The Iranian military command further warned that additional measures would be taken if 'aggression' continues.
caption:
Iran has shut down one of the world's most critical shipping lanes.

Iran's top joint military command, the Khatam al-Anbiya Central Headquarters, announced on Saturday that the Strait of Hormuz would be closed to vessel traffic.

The decision was reported by Iran's Mehr state news agency, citing alleged violations of a ceasefire agreement by the United States and Israel.

Military command stated that this closure serves as the 'first step' in response to what they described as breaches of commitments.

The Iranian military command further warned that additional measures would be taken if 'aggression' continues.

headline_marked: August launch: [[Dhaka-Pabna direct train service]] to begin
headline: August launch: Dhaka-Pabna direct train service to begin
summary: Railways Minister Shaikh Rabiul Alam announced the new service, stating that locomotives are ready and new coaches will arrive next month.
details: Railways Minister Shaikh Rabiul Alam has announced that a direct train service connecting Dhaka and Pabna is expected to launch in August.
Speaking to journalists in Pabna, the minister stated that the locomotive for the service is already prepared and new coaches are scheduled to arrive next month.
Once the coaches are delivered, the minister said the service will be launched on a priority basis to improve connectivity.
Beyond the Pabna route, Minister Rabiul also mentioned that a new train service between Dhaka and Khulna would be introduced in due course.
The government is currently working to develop an integrated multimodal transport network to bring greater discipline and safety to the country's transport sector.
The minister emphasized that transport-sector reforms are being undertaken in the broader public interest and not to benefit any specific group.
Additionally, a feasibility study is underway for a proposed Aricha-Khaschar ferry service to strengthen road and river connectivity.
caption:
Direct trains from Dhaka to Pabna are coming this August!

Railways Minister Shaikh Rabiul Alam has announced that a direct train service connecting Dhaka and Pabna is expected to launch in August.

Speaking to journalists in Pabna, the minister stated that the locomotive for the service is already prepared and new coaches are scheduled to arrive next month.

Once the coaches are delivered, the minister said the service will be launched on a priority basis to improve connectivity.

Beyond the Pabna route, Minister Rabiul also mentioned that a new train service between Dhaka and Khulna would be introduced in due course.

The government is currently working to develop an integrated multimodal transport network to bring greater discipline and safety to the country's transport sector.

The minister emphasized that transport-sector reforms are being undertaken in the broader public interest and not to benefit any specific group.

Additionally, a feasibility study is underway for a proposed Aricha-Khaschar ferry service to strengthen road and river connectivity.

#Bangladesh #Railways #Dhaka #Pabna #TransportNews

Source: The Daily Star, Dhaka Tribune, Somoy News
